items.markdown:
![20-Minute Pad Kra Pao (Thai Basil Pork) - Cooking Therapy](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280406-1672-0139-0000-b44198d04e27:6)
Pad Kra Pao is a famous Thai comfort food and street food stir-fry made with **minced meat, holy basil, garlic, and chilies** . It is typically served over hot jasmine rice and topped with a crispy fried egg.[](https://thaifex-anuga.com/editorials/what-is-pad-kra-pao/) [[1]](https://thaifex-anuga.com/editorials/what-is-pad-kra-pao/)[[2]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/pad-kra-pao-beef/)[[3]](https://nomadette.com/pad-kra-pao/)

Key Ingredients

- **Protein:** Minced pork, chicken, or beef (sometimes seafood or tofu).
- **Aromatics & Spice:** Lots of smashed garlic and fiery Thai bird's eye chilies.
- **The Herb:** Fresh holy basil (*kra pao* ), which has a sharp, peppery, and slightly clove-like aroma.
- **Sauce:** A mix of oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, and a little sugar.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/holy-basil-stir-fry/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/holy-basil-stir-fry/)[[2]](https://www.cooking-therapy.com/pad-kra-pao/)[[3]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/stir-fried-holy-basil)

Why It Is Popular

- It is considered by many locals to be the true national dish of Thailand for everyday eating.
- It cooks in just a few minutes over very high heat.
- It balances savory, salty, sweet, and very spicy flavors.[](https://thaifex-anuga.com/editorials/what-is-pad-kra-pao/) [[1]](https://thewoksoflife.com/pad-kra-pao/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/Deanedwardschef/posts/pad-kra-pao-this-recipe-traditionally-uses-thai-holy-basil-but-its-so-hard-to-fi/920533103228082/)
